description: Here’s my recipe for the best M&S cookie dupe ever… 🍪🤎 This recipe makes 5 cookies just like M&S. Recipe:  ♡  65g unsalted butter ♡  100g caster sugar ♡  45g light brown sugar ♡  1 large egg yolk  ♡  10g black treacle  ♡  1-2 tsp water ♡  1 tsp vanilla extract  ♡  130g plain flour ♡  25g whole milk powder ♡  ¼ tsp bicarbonate of soda ♡  ½ tsp fine salt ♡  170g chocolate Method:  ♡ Cream the butter, sugar and treacle together well ♡Mix in the egg yolk, vanilla extract and 1 tsp water  ♡ Add in the plain flour and milk powder. If your dough is crumbly at this stage add in the second tsp of water to loosen it ♡ Grate (yes with a cheesegrater) in 70g of the chocolate ♡ Chop the rest of the chocolate and mix it all into the dough  ♡ Roll the dough into 5 even balls (around 117g each) on some parchment paper and place them in the fridge overnight (if you’re impatient make sure they’ve been in there for at least an hour but the longer the better, I promise)  ♡ Bake them in the oven 170C FAN/ Gas Mark 3 for around 11 - 13 minutes. Keep your eye on them and when they come out of the oven, and are still warm, place a circular cookie cutter around the cookie and use a swirling motion to shape them back into perfect circles.  #mandscookies #cookierecipe #chocolatechipcookie #cookiedupe #marksandspencer
transcript: You're too good to be true like a dream with a view I would choose over a cashmere horizon. Like a castle in the air, we don't care, we're right there in your head.
